title: Felt lexer: tokenize .felt source files
description: Implement lexer using the logos crate (derive-macro DFA). Define a Token enum with #[derive(Logos)]. Tokens: keywords (fn, let, if, then, else, match, with, where, type, true, false, and, or, not), identifiers, int/float/string literals, operators (|>, ->, ==, !=, >=, <=, +, -, *, /, %, ++, ::), punctuation (parens, brackets, braces, comma, colon, =, backslash, pipe, underscore). Line comments with --. Produce spans for error reporting. Rust crate: felt/ directory. Dependencies: logos.
